market_summary: London morning session displays risk-on recovery across currencies and equity futures following the overnight selloff. EURUSD and GBPUSD have rebounded toward their respective Value Area Highs and Session High resistances, triggering HOLDs due to muted RVOL and overhead resistance. US100 displays clear momentum acceptance above EMA50 and VAH targeting Session High, qualifying for a high-probability scalp. BTCUSD remains subdued below VAL and VWAP, consolidating just above session lows without sufficient follow-through volume.

signals.rationale: Evaluated checklist: 1) VP context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10773 - VAH 1.10981), close is above POC 1.10933, but capped right beneath VAH/Session High 1.10988. 2) CVD is NEUTRAL (+2,429) with positive slope (+910.65). 3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price reclaimed VWAP (1.10844) and EMA50 (1.10875) cleanly. 5) ATR position is mid-to-upper channel near 1.10959. 6) Volume confirmation is lacking with RVOL 1.051 (no yellow spike). 7) Price is approaching Session High resistance at 1.10988 inside the value area without breakout volume; prefer HOLD rather than buying into resistance.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above rising VWAP and EMA50

signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish bounce above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Evaluated checklist: 1) VP context: Price is below VAL (73416.41) and below POC (73541.61). 2) CVD is -0.03 (BEARISH) with flat/negative slope (-0.0), matching the downtrend. 3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend is firmly bearish below VWAP (73633.66) and EMA50 (73653.70). 5) ATR position is consolidating near mid-to-lower channel. 6) RVOL is low at 0.987 with no volume spike. 7) Price is hovering right above Session Low (73166.0) and Prev Low (73097.30), forming an indecisive consolidation after a heavy flush.
